name_input: WALKSEA INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED; WALKSEA INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: No export record found. ImportKey page for slug 'walksea-industries-private-limited' reports "Total Shipments 20 Records detected" and every visible row is an INBOUND shipment into India, e.g. "2025-09-30 | WALKSEA INDUSTRIES PRIVATE LIMITED | THE CACAO FACTORY SDN BHD | COCOA POWDER | STP - 2 NHAVA SHEVA SEA, India | KLANG, MALAYSIA | 18050000 | 6611578" — i.e. Walksea is the Indian BUYER/consignee, Malaysia is origin. Rows actually seen: 5 of 20 (dates 2025-09-30, 2025-08-18, 2025-07-28, 2025-07-03, 2025-06-10; B/L 6611578, 3941394, 3532695, 3044466, 2561037; all HS 18050000, all origin Indonesia/Malaysia -> Nhava Sheva / Patparganj ICD). No outbound (India -> foreign destination) bill of lading with a date was observed. Source counter: 20 shipments claimed vs 5 rows visible; 0 export rows visible.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award, contract or annual-report split located in the sources reachable. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned connection errors on both attempts, so no domestic-supply query could be completed; volza, eximpedia and trademo returned HTTP 403. Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not zero.
note: Role appears to be importer/distributor of cocoa powder (HS 180500) into India, not an exporter. Declared HS codes 151790/180100/180500 are consistent with the cocoa/food-ingredient trade actually observed, but the observed flow is import-side only; no export shipments with date, destination and B/L number were found, so export_status = none_found rather than declared_only. Domestic (India) supply activity is unverified — no GST turnover, tender or contract evidence was retrievable, so it is recorded as unknown/null, not as 'no supplies'. Per Rule 5 no softening: no trace of outbound supply was found in the customs data reviewed. Caveat: only one free-view source (ImportKey) was accessible; volza/eximpedia/trademo/importgenius were blocked (403) and web_search was down, so absence of export records is based on a single source and a 5-of-20 row sample. No revenue or export-volume figures are public in the sources seen — left null, not estimated.
